cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says government payments are checked against the national ID or a social registry.
cells.note: AMEN cash transfers are paid by e-wallet card (World Bank, April 2024), and about 65% of pensions are withdrawn by ATM from Tunisia Post accounts (November 2026): two main streams, so stage 4. No check against the ID or a registry is held, so not stage 5.
